body.prompt: A thick column of dark grey-blue smoke rising from a burning wreck on the ground, seen from the side: billowing puffs that widen as they rise, darker at the base. Bold simple silhouette, high contrast, chunky cloud shapes, isolated on a plain white background

assets.prompt: A centered, vertical column of dark gray-blue smoke rises from a compact, low wreck silhouette resting on the ground. The smoke is darkest and densest at its base, then separates into chunky, rounded billows that widen toward the top. Hard-edged lighter blue-gray patches define the upper-facing sides of each puff, with bold, even outlines and a clear two-tone cel-shaded finish. A small, restrained orange flame is visible at the base of the smoke, partially obscuring the wreck. Keep the entire sprite isolated against solid white, with open space around it.

assets.prompt: A broad column of dark gray-blue smoke rises from a small burning wreck at ground level, its outline forming distinct overlapping cloud shapes. The lower section is tightly packed and nearly charcoal-dark; higher up, the puffs expand outward in alternating rounded lobes, with a slight side-to-side stagger. Flat blue-gray highlights sit on one side of the billows, separated from the dark areas by crisp edges and a bold, even outline. A limited orange flame at the base indicates the burning source without competing with the smoke. Center the complete sprite on solid white with clear margins.

assets.prompt: A centered smoke plume rises from a low, partially obscured wreck silhouette on the ground.
